title: Pakistan Air Force Extension of the Service Act 1952

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Air Force Extension of the Service Act 1952
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1952
THE PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1952.
ACT No. XLVI of 1952
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1952,
Pt. IX, p. 7.]
[9th
December, 1952]
An Act to provide for the retention in service of certain persons
enrolled for service in the Pakistan Air Force.
[The original word Royal omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and
Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).]
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called the
Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Act, 1952. [The
original word Royal omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from
the 23rd March, 1956).]
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Air Force Extension of the Service Act 1952
sections.description:
Extension of service where term of service has expired

THE PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1952
THE PAKISTAN AIR FORCE (EXTENSION OF SERVICE) ACT, 1952.
ACT No. XLVI of 1952
[For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1952,
Pt. IX, p. 7.]
[9th
December, 1952]
An Act to provide for the retention in service of certain persons
enrolled for service in the Pakistan Air Force.
[The original word Royal omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and
Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).]
2. Extension of service where term of service has expired. Until such
date as may be notified in this behalf by the Central Government, any person
enrolled for service in the [The original word Royal
omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd
March, 1956).] Pakistan Air Force who, by reason of the expiry of the
term for which he was engaged to serve when so enrolled, is no longer liable
for service shall, notwithstanding such expiry, continue to be enrolled for
service and to be liable for service in the [The
original word Royal omitted by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from
the 23rd March, 1956).] Pakis tan Air Force until he is
discharged by the orders of the prescribed officer under the Indian Air Force
Act, 1932 [Ins. by Ord. 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd
Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).] [or the
Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953]: XIV of 1932.
Provided that
the period for which the service of any such person is extended under this Act
shall not exceed six years from the day on which his service would otherwise
have terminated:
Provided
further, that for the purpose of this Act any person whose form of enrolment
shows that he was enrolled for the duration of the war and for so long
thereafter as his services may be required shall be deemed to have been so
enrolled for a period of nine years commencing with the date of his original
enrol ment.
